claims.claim: Preloved sewing table top machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white electric sewing machine on a stand, but do not confirm it is preloved or a table-top unit.
Brand text “TOYOTA” is visible, but the photos do not show a country-of-origin marking.
Photos do not show the machine powered on or running.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual are included.
claims.evidence: Witness report notes accessories/manual not shown; photos do not show foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet, or manual.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service history or internal inspection is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Motor/drive may be weak or noisy even if it looks intact; stitching performance depends on motor health.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powered on with the foot pedal engaged, showing the needle moving and consistent feed (include a close-up of the needle/presser foot while stitching a simple straight line).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-tested/unknown-working electric sewing machine (worst case: may need servicing).

risks.risk: Missing or incompatible accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet) can make it unusable or require extra spending.
risks.proof: A single clear photo/clip laying out every included accessory on the floor/table: foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet set, and the manual (with all items visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine-only or incomplete kit (worst case: accessories/manual not included).

risks.risk: Internal timing/feed mechanism issues (feed dogs, tension unit, belt/gears) may not be visible externally.
risks.proof: A video clip stitching at least two fabric types (e.g., cotton and denim) showing even feed and correct tension (no skipping, no thread bunching).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing adjustment/repair (worst case: timing/tension problems).

risks.risk: Exact model/serial number not readable; could be a different variant with different parts availability.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the model/serial plate (or any label) with the text readable, plus a photo of the underside/belt area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest end for Toyota-branded electric sewing machines with unknown exact model/parts compatibility.

risks.risk: Surface wear may hide prior damage or repairs (e.g., cracks, bent needle bar, worn presser foot).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, presser foot, feed dogs, and any visible joints/hinges from multiple angles (including underside if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming normal wear but with unknown hidden damage (worst case: cosmetic wear plus possible functional issues).

proof_requests: Video: power-on + foot pedal engaged, needle moving continuously (show needle/presser foot close-up).
Video: stitch a straight line on at least two fabrics (e.g., cotton and denim) showing even feed and correct tension.
Photo/clip: lay out and show every accessory included (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, presser feet set, manual).
Close-up: readable model/serial number plate (and underside/belt area if accessible).
Close-ups: needle area, feed dogs, tension/presser foot mechanism, and any visible wear points.
response.reason: The witness confirms the machine’s brand/appearance, but key value drivers (powers on/runs smoothly, included accessories/manual, and stitching performance) are not shown. Without those proofs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
